title: The Guide: the Book's pages on day 12
about: QA round. A guided game on spring 12 at 20:00 at home: the Guide holds gold, crops, jobs, friends, skills, making things, fishing and the mine (sprinklers and jars arrived early with the place goal). Gold and crops are read; the rest show NEW. Open a page: its title, short paragraphs, Back and (when it runs over) More. Toggle Goods for the almanac.
